meta.title: Example Bay & Ridge · an eight-day sample
meta.description: A made-up eight-day trip with two bases and two transfer days, shaped like the family’s v15 page, showing every component of the holiday coffee-table template.

masthead.kicker: Travel coffee-table kit · a fictional sample
masthead.title: Example Bay & the *Lantern* Coast
masthead.lede: Two unhurried days of harbour light, a lighthouse, sea cliffs and a Sunday market. Every place here is invented.
masthead.edition: Kit sample · every name, number and link is invented · all times local

overview.title: One base. Two gentle days.

plans.title: Weather swaps, and our own.
plans.intro: Each day has Plan A. If it rains, or if it's hot, windy or stormy, the day has a swap for the weather; the forecast highlights it and never hides another. At many stops we can also swap: Plan B for walks and nature, Plan C for shopping, Plan D for early or late. Choosing B and C together means we split up and meet again.

explain.b: Covered and indoor alternatives, close to the base.

rules.text: Rain chance 60% or more: the rain swap
Maximum 32°C or more: the heat swap
Wind gusts 55 km/h or more: the heat swap
